=== task: stop:all ===

  docker stop $ids
  echo "Stopping $(echo "$ids" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') container(s)..."
  echo 'All containers stopped.'
  echo 'No running containers to stop.'
else
fi
if [ -n "$ids" ]; then
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_stop:all:unix" finished
task: "_stop:all:unix" started
task: "_stop:all:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: "stop:all" finished
task: "stop:all" started
task: [_install:macos] brew install --cask docker
task: [_install:macos] brew update
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Docker Desktop installed. Open the Docker app to complete initial setup.'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing Docker Desktop via Homebrew...'
task: [_stop:all:unix] ids=$(docker ps -q 2>/dev/null)
task: status command command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -z "BASE-VERSION" ] || docker --version | grep -Fq "BASE-VERSION"; } exited non-zero: exit status 1
